summary: Aldeyra Therapeutics filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting minutes from a Type A meeting with the FDA regarding a potential NDA resubmission for reproxalap (dry eye disease). The registrant requested clarification and intends to request a Type D meeting expected by Q3 2026. No deal terms, M&A, restructuring, or special-situation transaction is disclosed. The filing is a routine regulatory update, not a special situation.
